generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL. When the instance is a copy of the compact database, generated PKs start at MAX(existing PK)+1 so they never collide with compact rows. PK columns are exempt from duplicate-share and group-size post-processing.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Draw from the union of compact parent values (schema.original_values[(parent_table, parent_column)]) and generated parent values actually present in the instance; never emit a value absent from that union. For nullable FKs include NULL rows and non-NULL rows. For NOT NULL FKs the pool is never empty (fall back to compact values).
generic_sampling_rules.integer_generic: Uniform integer in [1, 1000]; include boundary values 1, 2, 3 and one step around each listed literal.
generic_sampling_rules.decimal_amount: Uniform decimal in [0, 1000] with 2-4 fractional digits; include 0 and values near listed literals.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_name: Random person-like name from a small pool; include near-duplicate variants (case, spacing) and exact duplicates for DISTINCT targets.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_short: Random short token of 3-15 chars; include near-variants of listed literals.
generic_sampling_rules.char_code: Pick from the column's enum pool; include near-variants (case, truncation) of listed literals.
generic_sampling_rules.datetime: Random datetime in 2016-01-01..2018-12-31 formatted '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'; respect table date-order rules. Perturbation for distinctness adds/subtracts a timedelta and re-formats with the column format, never string concatenation.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_date: Random integer in [1, 31] representing a day-of-month.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, at least one NULL row per instance; share follows the compact database's observed NULL share for that column (fallback ~10-20% when the compact share is 0). NULLs are planted before distinct-value and FK repair; a planted NULL is never replaced to satisfy a rule.

supporting_evidence.Policies.Start_Date <= End_Date: Soft rule for generated rows only; compact row 151 (2017-12-20 > 2017-09-16) is exempt. Generated rows always satisfy it.
supporting_evidence.Amounts non-negative: All shown Amount_Claimed and Amount_Piad values are >= 0.
supporting_evidence.Enums: Distinct values observed in statistics match the listed enum pools.
supporting_evidence.PK disjointness: Generated PKs start at MAX(existing PK)+1 per table so they never collide with compact rows; FK values are drawn from the union of compact and generated parent values actually present in the instance.
supporting_evidence.FK pool fix: FK sampling uses schema.original_values[(parent_table, parent_column)] union generated parent values; NOT NULL FK pools fall back to compact values so they are never empty.
supporting_evidence.Childless parents: Realized by reserving at least one parent PK value and excluding it from the child FK draw; never by planting NULL into a NOT NULL FK column.
supporting_evidence.PK exemption: PK columns (Customers.Customer_ID, Policies.Policy_ID, Claim_Headers.Claim_Header_ID, Claims_Processing.Claim_Processing_ID, Claims_Processing_Stages.Claim_Stage_ID) are removed from DISTINCT_COLUMNS and GROUP_SIZE_COLUMNS; group-size/unmatched-join targets are realized on the join result via child FK distribution.
supporting_evidence.Datetime perturbation: Distinctness for datetime columns adds/subtracts a timedelta and re-formats with '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'; date-order is re-applied after perturbation.
supporting_evidence.FK-target post-processing: Group-size/duplicate-share on Claims_Processing.Claim_Stage_ID and Claims_Processing_Stages.Claim_Status_Name is applied before FK assignment, or FKs are re-validated and repaired after post-processing so Claims_Processing.Claim_Stage_ID and Next_Claim_Stage_ID always reference existing stage IDs.

uncertainty: No formula linking Amount_Piad to Amount_Claimed holds on all shown rows (Amount_Piad exceeds Amount_Claimed in several rows), so no such formula is stated. Next_Claim_Stage_ID self-reference is nullable and only observed value is 1; treated as optional self-FK with pool = compact + generated stage IDs. Policies.Start_Date <= End_Date is contradicted by compact row 151; stated as a soft rule constraining generated rows only, with compact rows exempt. NULLs form their own group for COUNT(DISTINCT) targets and are excluded from the '>= 2 distinct non-NULL values per group' requirement; _ensure_distinct_values is applied after _plant_nulls and is NULL-aware. duplicate_share is interpreted as the fraction of rows that repeat a value (so COUNT(DISTINCT) lies between 50% and 80% of row count). Whether the compact database contains Claims_Processing_Stages rows is unconfirmed; if absent, the self-FK rule is vacuously satisfied by the generated-only pool.
